messages:
dan: Quick thread — publishing strategy for the JS/TS SDK. Single package with conditional exports (cjs+esm+edge) or split into `-edge` package?

lynn: Single-package + exports is nicer for consumers (one dependency). But needs careful `exports` map so bundlers pick the right entry. Example: `"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" } }`

pete: Heads-up: TS and `exports` interplay is tricky. Typescript only resolves `types` if it's at the package root or if `exports` provides `types` subpath. For users on older TS (<4.7) or older bundlers, include `main`/`module` fallbacks and `types: "dist/index.d.ts"`.

nina: Runtime gotchas: edge bundles must avoid `process`, `fs`, node `crypto`. Use `globalThis.crypto` and lazy-read env (constructor opts) so require-time evaluation doesn't pull node shims. Also make retry/backoff runtime-agnostic (accept AbortSignal + scheduler).

dan: Another practical option: keep single package but publish a tiny `dist/edge` artifact and an explicit subpath import: `import sdk from '@redwood/infer-sdk/edge'` — docs + examples required.

lynn: Add smoke tests CI matrix: Node 14/16/18, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno. Bun/Deno sometimes prefer `module` field; ensure ESM entry exists.

pete: Small sample apps are key to reduce onboarding friction. Add `examples/worker/wrangler` that imports `@redwood/infer-sdk/edge` and a README showing `wrangler.toml` and `env` setup.

nina: Publishing-wise: incremental PRs — 1) build target for edge (no node polyfills), 2) package.json exports + types at root, 3) examples + CI matrix, 4) retry fixes and abort tests.

publish-bot: publish: draft v2.1.2 created. artifacts: cjs 118kb, esm 82kb, edge 44kb.

dan: OK — I'll write a short RFC and link to the example PRs. If anyone has additional TS/bundler quirks (parcel/rollup/vite), drop them here before RFC is final.
